Title: Client Onboarding Case Hub
Description: Provide one visible process for onboarding requests from submission to resolution
Acceptance Criteria: Requests can be created prioritised assigned tracked and resolved

Title: Submit an onboarding request
Description: As a client I want to submit my onboarding request so that the service team can begin setup
Acceptance Criteria: Required customer request type and priority fields are captured

Title: Track an active request
Description: As a service owner I want to view active onboarding cases so that I can manage follow-up
Acceptance Criteria: Active cases show customer priority owner and status

Title: Notify the service owner
Description: As a service owner I want to receive a notification when a request is submitted so that I can respond promptly
Acceptance Criteria: An automated email or Teams notification is sent when a request is created

Title: View service reporting
Description: As a manager I want to view case status and priority so that I can monitor onboarding workload
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows case count by status and priority

Title: Create UAT evidence
Description: Record test result for a submitted high-priority onboarding request
Acceptance Criteria: Expected and actual outcomes are documented
